notes.title: Patch 0.28.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you all so much for the feedback you’ve been giving us. It really helps make the game better.
We’re continuing to work on it, and today’s update brings several new side quests, enemy reinforcement waves, and many bug fixes and minor improvements.
The next update is just around the corner and will introduce a "Feats" system—mini-quests for each character that grant bonuses upon completion.

Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Added 3 new side quests.
[*] Added battles with enemy reinforcement waves.
[*] Treasure points on the map, which previously could grant items/spells/heroes, are now split into 3 distinct types.
[*] Contracts that were previously unfulfilled are now prioritized.
[*] Fixed a bug where attack/spell ranges were incorrectly displayed when a hero was in a corner of the map.
[*] Fixed a bug where harpoon kills left lingering VFX.
[*] Illusions no longer deal armor damage.
[*] Allied illusions are now marked in the UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Hunter’s "Fas" ability drained action points from summoned wolves.
[*] Fixed a bug where killing with a trap did not free the dead unit’s cell.
[*] When an enemy summons an illusion, unit portraits are now randomized to prevent identifying which is the illusion.
[*] Ghouls can no longer burrow into a cell already occupied by another burrowing ghoul.
[*] The Water Spirit’s catfish will now spit out a swallowed character when the boss phase changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Spear Song is participating in the Turn-Based RPG Steam Fest!
notes.content:
Spear Song is participating in the Turn-Based RPG Steam Fest!
Try our demo, leave feedback in the community Discord!

We also released a new trailer for the upcoming Early Access release on October 10th, with all the main features of the game!
[previewyoutube=7rbbZqME97s;full][/previewyoutube]

- Turn-based tactics in a world of Slavic fairytales
- Upgrade your heroes, their abilities and your capital
- Travel through different areas
- Hunt the monsters
- The fate of the kingdom is in your hands 

We hope for your feedback, so try the demo, join the discord, and leave your reviews!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Y6FKwK2hnE

notes.title: New demo available now!
notes.content:
Finally! The new demo of the Spear Song is now available on  Steam! We've created a new page for demo, so leave your review on this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505190/__Demo/]page [/url]down below!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505190/__Demo/

A lot of ideas have been implemented and many of them are based on your feedback!
List of changes:
- The mechanics of leveling up characters have been reworked. Now each character has experience, an ability tree and different characteristics.
- The mechanics of leveling up improvements in the city have been reworked
- Now the player can choose a starting squad with which to go on a campaign. Classes of available characters are gradually opening up
- Multiple interface improvements
- Character models have been updated
- Environment models have been updated
- Added mechanics for choosing a reward
- Added support for controllers
- Added an option to disable camera shake
- Added an option to increase the font size
- Added an option to speed up animations
- Added elements of the interactive environment
- Added the ability to sell items and spells
- Improved sound design

We hope for your feedback, so try the build, join the discord, and leave feedback on the demo!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Y6FKwK2hnE

notes.title: Demo update v0.23.1
notes.content:
We have updated the demo version for the "Games to be" festival. 
List of changes: 
[list] 
[*] Added bug report section to the menu, fixing bugs is now easier. 
[*] Removed the need to double-click on the target to run up-attack, the unit now does everything himself. 
[*] Added some sounds for the boss Lich One-Eyed. 
[*] The boss also has the ability to summon weakening totems. Battle with him has become more complex. 
[*] Revised the mechanics of the areas where the contract is executed. These are now special areas where there is an element of surprise and choice. 
[*] Units with a long-range attack are highlighted with a special icon. 
[*] The energy scale is now animated when filled. 
[*] Fixed the display of the area progress bar. 
[*] Updated some unit models 
[*] Fixed several critical bugs 
[/list].
